dialogs.text: Most common BACTERIAL cause of acute pharyngitis and tonsillitis

tips.front: Recall the Lancefield group classification of streptococci

dialogs.text: Classic cause of acute epiglottitis in unvaccinated children

tips.front: This pathogen is prevented by the Hib conjugate vaccine in the UIP schedule

dialogs.text: Most common bacterial causes of acute sinusitis
dialogs.answer: Streptococcus pneumoniae (commonest), followed by non-typeable Haemophilus influenzae

tips.front: The same organism also tops the list for community-acquired pneumonia

dialogs.text: URTI pathogen identified by Albert stain showing blue-black metachromatic granules
dialogs.answer: Corynebacterium diphtheriae — Gram-positive pleomorphic rod arranged in Chinese letter pattern

tips.front: Metachromatic granules are also called volutin granules
